create_download_object: create a Download object from a Playwright page with a download URL and suggested filename
save_download_file: save a Playwright Download object to a specified local file path using save_as
cancel_download: cancel an in-progress Playwright Download object before it finishes
get_download_failure: get the failure reason string from a failed Playwright Download object
get_download_path: get the local file path of a completed Playwright Download object
